content.short: Privy is the easiest Web3 onboarding solution, enabling dApps to support both social login and traditional crypto wallets seamlessly on Mantle.
content.description: Privy is an authentication and wallet management platform making Web3 onboarding seamless for all users, whether they have existing crypto wallets or are entirely new to blockchain. Developers integrate Privy to offer email, phone, and social login options that automatically create embedded wallets for new users, while supporting MetaMask and other traditional wallets for existing users. Deployed on Mantle, Privy helps dApps reach mainstream audiences without sacrificing Web3 functionality.
content.meta: Privy simplifies Web3 onboarding with social login and embedded wallets for all users on Mantle. Discover Privy on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
